## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check`, `black --check`, `pyrefly check` and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by tests (regression test for bug fixes)
- [ ] Public API changes are backwards compatible or come with a `DeprecationWarning`
- [ ] `CHANGES.rst` has an entry under the current dev section
- [ ] Docstrings / docs updated (autosummary lists, tutorials only if needed)
- [ ] No generated files edited by hand (`*_pb2.py*`, `_version.py`)
